summary.goal: Create the backend project entity that links ideation sessions, plans, and forge runs into a single project.

acceptance_criteria.description: projects table created via migration with columns: id, name, owner_id, initiative_id, session_id, plan_id, run_id, config (JSONB), current_focus (JSONB), created_at, updated_at
POST /api/projects creates a project (also creates linked ideation session + plan)
GET /api/projects/:id returns project with linked entity summaries
PUT /api/projects/:id updates project fields (name, config, linked IDs)
POST /api/projects/:id/focus stores current_focus on project entity
config column stores ProjectConfig with scopes (workspace_path, remote_url, default_branch) and execution_policy (max_concurrent, timeout, retries, budget)
useProjectEvents composition hook subscribes to all 3 SSE streams (ideation, planner, forge) for a project
Frontend fetches project on ProjectPage mount and provides via ProjectContext

observations: This is genuinely new backend work — the projects table doesn't exist today
It's the glue that links session_id (ideation), plan_id (planner), and run_id (forge) into one entity
The API follows existing patterns (Express + SQLite + Zod validation)
The useProjectEvents hook composes existing SSE hooks (useSessionEvents, usePlanEvents, useRunEvents) rather than creating a new SSE endpoint
ProjectConfig schema is new — defines scopes and execution_policy
current_focus is a JSONB column storing whatever the user is currently looking at (step_id, tree path, etc.)
questions: Should projects live in planner.db or a new tend.db?
Do we need a projects_users join table for multi-user access?
Should project creation auto-create session + plan or allow manual linking?

steps.title: Create projects table migration
steps.description: Follow migration pattern from packages/planner/src/storage/migrations/. Create projects table with columns: id (TEXT PRIMARY KEY), name (TEXT NOT NULL), owner_id, initiative_id, session_id, plan_id, run_id, config (JSONB), current_focus (JSONB), created_at, updated_at. Use BaseSqliteStorage migration system.

steps.title: Create ProjectStorage class
steps.description: Copy storage pattern from packages/planner/src/storage/plan-storage.ts. Extend BaseSqliteStorage with CRUD methods: list(), create(), getById(), update(), updateFocus(). Handle JSONB serialization for config and current_focus fields.

steps.title: Create Express router with 6 endpoints
steps.description: Copy router pattern from packages/planner/src/routes.ts. Create GET /api/projects (list), POST /api/projects (create, auto-creates linked session+plan via ideation/planner APIs), GET /:id (get with linked entities), PUT /:id (update), POST /:id/focus (update current_focus), POST /:id/graduate (stub, completed in graduation-bridge feature).

steps.title: Add Zod validation schemas
steps.description: Copy validation pattern from packages/planner/src/validation/. Create CreateProjectRequest, UpdateProjectRequest, FocusRequest, ProjectConfig schemas. Export TypeScript types from Zod schemas for consistency.

steps.title: Mount project router in server
steps.description: Edit packages/server/src/server.ts. Import createProjectRouter, initialize ProjectStorage, mount at /api/projects following existing pattern (planner, ideation, forge routers).

steps.title: Create useProjectEvents composition hook
steps.description: Copy composition pattern from existing hooks. Create useProjectEvents(project) that composes useSessionEvents (ideation SSE), usePlanEvents (planner SSE), useRunEvents (forge SSE). No new SSE endpoint — pure frontend composition. Hook should update forming blocks, tree, and execution status from the three streams.

steps.title: Create ProjectContext provider
steps.description: Copy context pattern from packages/planner-ui/src/contexts/PlanEditorContext.tsx. Create ProjectContext that fetches project via GET /api/projects/:id on mount, subscribes to SSE via useProjectEvents, provides project data + linked entities to children. Used by ProjectPage.

architect.sse_strategy: compose existing hooks, no new endpoint
